msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia teixits-donna-22.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Boutique campaign still life of rolls of sequined and embroidered lace fabrics in many colours from the reference. The product sits in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm natural light, soft textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia teixits-donna-18.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a printed silk fabric with colourful swirls from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia teixits-donna-37.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of double gauze muslin fabric in sage, navy and mustard from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia teixits-donna-22.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of embroidered sequin lace fabric from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia teixits-donna-21.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a resinated cotton tablecloth fabric with a botanical print from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail.
